headline: How RFK Jr.’s vaccine agenda risks resurgence of deadly childhood plagues
summary: Louisiana Surgeon General Dr. Evelyn Griffin, a Baton Rouge obstetrician, was appointed by HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. to the CDC’s vaccine advisory panel, which has moved to slash recommended childhood immunizations and replace experts with vaccine skeptics. Gov. Jeff Landry met with Kennedy at Pennington Biomedical Research Center for a bill signing ceremony, signaling state alignment with federal policies that have triggered a nationwide measles surge and threaten to limit vaccine access. These developments raise concerns that Louisiana could face resurgences of preventable diseases like measles, Hib, and diphtheria as vaccination rates decline and manufacturer liability protections erode.
